LESSON: SELECTED CHAPTERS 90:1

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Qur’an 1.1 Ulumul Qur’an (8 lessons) By the end of the sub-strand, the learner s
Topic 1.2: Selected Chapters 90:1

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Selected Chapters 90:1. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What lessons do Muslims learn from the selected surah?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read surah Ad-Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) and surah Al-Balad (Q. 90:1-20) correctly for spiritual nourishment
2. explain the meaning of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) for better understanding
3. apply the teachings of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93: 1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) in their daily life to earn rewards from Allah
4. appreciate the teachings of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93: 1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) as a guide in daily life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: SELECTED CHAPTERS 90:1
This lesson teaches Selected Chapters 90:1 for Grade 7 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. read surah Ad-Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) and surah Al-Balad (Q. 90:1-20) correctly for spiritual nourishment
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. explain the meaning of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) for better understanding
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. apply the teachings of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93: 1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) in their daily life to earn rewards from Allah
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
4. appreciate the teachings of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93: 1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) as a guide in daily life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Selected Chapters 90:1 using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Selected Chapters 90:1 above.
2. Explain Selected Chapters 90:1 to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Selected Chapters 90:1.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Selected Chapters 90:1 with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Selected Chapters 90:1 important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What lessons do Muslims learn from the selected surah?
2. How can a Muslim apply the teachings of the selected surah?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read surah Ad-Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) and surah Al-Balad (Q. 90:1-20) correctly for spiritual nourishment
2. explain the meaning of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) for better understanding
3. apply the teachings of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93: 1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) in their daily life to earn rewards from Allah
4. appreciate the teachings of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93: 1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) as a guide in daily life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
